firstTurnCombatRestriction.why: Axis units setting up in Romania cannot attack in the opening Axis Combat phase. That phase precedes all Axis movement.

notYetIntegrated.sovietRomanianBorderAttacks: §10.8 permits attacks on Axis units in Romanian territory only by Soviet units originally set up in 0708, 0808 or 1110. This needs immutable opening-position lineage and a certified Romanian territory set; do not infer it from current positions or the four Axis setup crosses.
